scope: Whole upstream repository synchronization; native rule data/metadata update only; retain personalized AllInOne and all personal files.
manual_review_decisions: Read actual old/new source rule payload differences and metadata, with all 530 versions archived and Git-blob matched. Only 265 rule/ files changed; no additions, deletions or mode changes.

ChinaMax full changes 123772 to 123483 rows: 22 domain additions and 309 removals plus one added and three removed networks. Retain native formats and exact upstream bytes, including the 240b:4006:1100::/45 IPv6 change.
TikTok adds only DOMAIN-SUFFIX capcutapi.com, capcutapi.us and capcutstatic.com. The corresponding Clash/Loon/Shadowrocket/QuantumultX data use their original source representations.
Apple, Blizzard and Game only change metadata. AdGuard AdvertisingLite and Privacy only change ignored metadata; their active filters are identical. Surge AdvertisingLite rule files are unchanged.

All 47 README changes are timestamps and numeric rule counts. All 56 changed YAML payloads parse with CSafeLoader. Six DOMAIN-SET change sets match the full Surge domain actions after preserving leading-dot suffix semantics.

All non-rule upstream entries, including AllInOne, scripts, authors, LICENSE and workflows, are unchanged. Current AllInOne bytes and both mutable runtime JS dependencies match their exact reviewed baselines; scripts were compiled without execution.

Preserve the user-confirmed advertisement and advertising Pinterest/Pinimg authority exclusions verbatim; retain every personal file and historical review. No configuration/runtime adaptation, diagnostic split, cloud operation, device test or website restoration.

The whole source rule subtree is reused only after complete three-way proof and actual data review. Parent history retains both the current personal head and reviewed upstream head. No reset or force update.
